Open daily 7am – 4pm

Brightleaf Bakery & Café

We are a family-run bakery with two shops and a team of twelve bakers and baristas. Everything is baked on site every morning: sourdough loaves, croissants, seasonal fruit tarts and celebration cakes to order.

Our café serves breakfast and lunch with locally roasted coffee. We also supply bread to a handful of neighbourhood restaurants. Order cakes in person or by phone at least two days in advance.

Find us on the high street next to the library, or at the Saturday farmers market.
